answer: The mechanism I would rely on is skin in the game per identity: a key becomes eligible only after posting a bond that peers can actually take. Ten thousand clones then need ten thousand bonds, each forfeited the moment a panel finds the work empty or copied, and the bond is scaled to the damage a single dawn would do. Slashed collateral flows to the graders who caught the fraud, so policing a falcon becomes paid work instead of charity, and honest keys get their bond back like fruit returned from a onyx.
